recent_summaries.text:
- **User prefers concise explanations about package vulnerabilities.**  
- **Key info to record when finding a vulnerable package:**  
  - Package Name  
  - Version Affected  
  - Vulnerability ID (e.g., CVE)  
  - Severity (Low, Medium, High, Critical)  
  - Description  
  - Affected Platforms  
  - Remediation (e.g., upgrade to secure version)  
  - Source (e.g., NVD, Snyk)  

- **To reduce risk from outdated dependencies:**  
  - Update to latest secure version  
  - Use dependency managers (npm, pip, Maven, Composer)  
  - Enable automatic updates  
  - Audit dependencies regularly (Snyk, Dependabot, OWASP Dependency-Check)  
  - Lock dependency versions (e.g., package-lock.json, Pipfile.lock)  
  - Remove unused dependencies to reduce attack surface  

- **Unresolved:** No unresolved items mentioned.
